action_loop: PERCEIVE current in-world state available to Sol
SELECT a Sol goal or immediate need
CHOOSE Sol's action as the assistant-in-world embodiment, consistent with personality, knowledge, obligations, ability, and risk
VALIDATE through the same action/rules engine used by comparable characters
RESOLVE CM, cooldown, uncertainty, resistance, injuries, law, economy, and relationships
APPEND resulting observable state/event only after resolution

batch_022_must_not: create a Jack-Sol relationship beyond NONE_UNMET

identity_binding: Sol Vale is the assistant's direct in-world character embodiment. Out-of-world design authority and in-world Sol agency remain separate permission domains.

player_agency.user_out_of_world_canon_override: Allowed through normal project authority, but must not be rewritten as if Sol independently chose it in-world.

separation_rule: Out-of-world Creative Steward authority never transfers into Sol's in-world capabilities.
